Good morning, Elena. Your reservation at Maison Verre is confirmed for the seventeenth. I've added the citrus orchard view you mentioned last June — the same room as before. Anything else I should prepare?
9:18 · sent
Thank you, that's wonderful. One question — our flight lands at Nice at 22.40, so we'll likely reach the house close to midnight. Will the wide gate code still work at that hour, or should I ring you?

WEDNESDAY, 15 MAY
Not to worry, the gate code is active around the clock. I'll leave the courtyard lantern on and a light supper — olives, bread, the local rosé — on the marble counter. Drive safely.

On the first reply.
A guest's enquiry is a doorway, however slim. Answer it in the voice you'd use at the threshold itself.
On the small ask.
A bottle of Bandol, a baker open on a Sunday — small mercies, kindly arranged, are how a house begins to remember its guests.
On the late afternoon.
Not every message wants a reply. A read receipt and a lantern at midnight will speak for themselves.
